blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Clinical decision making heavily relies on predicting the disease progression trajectory by seeking to understand patient’s health status which is characterised by multimodal medical data. AI holds great potential for learning useful representations from multimodal medical data to predict disease progression and aid clinical decision making. However, development of predictive AI models is constrained by missing modalities and incomplete tabular data frequently occurring in medical datasets. In addition, disease labels alone may only provide limited supervisory signals for learning representations from high-dimensional multimodal data. Here, we present MMAP, a novel Multimodal Missing-aware Alignment Pretraining method for learning image-tabular representations from incomplete data. An image encoder is pretrained with efficient sigmoid contrastive learning combined with generative reconstruction. A tabular encoder is built upon a tabular foundation model. A missing token generator enables the two encoders to take incomplete data as input, enabling the model to be robust against missing modalities, either with missing images or missing tabular data.
We evaluate the clinical usefulness of the learnt multimodal representations on two challenging longitudinal clinical tasks for Alzheimer’s disease: predicting disease stage conversion and predicting amyloid status. The proposed method outperforms strong multimodal and unimodal baselines.
blocks.zh:
临床决策很大程度上依赖于预测疾病的发展轨迹,寻求了解患者的健康状况,其特征是多种模式的医疗数据。 大赦国际具有很大潜力,可以从多模式医疗数据中学习有用的表述,以预测疾病的进展和协助临床决策。 然而,由于医疗数据集中经常出现模式缺失和表格数据不完整,预测性AI模型的开发受到制约. 此外,仅疾病标签可能只能为从高维多模式数据学习表现提供有限的监督信号. 在此,我们介绍MMAP,这是一种新型的Multimodule miss-aware understanding Pretraining方法,用于从不完整的数据中学习图像表表示. 图像编码器通过高效的Sigmoid对比性学习与基因重建结合进行预训. 表格编码器以表格基础模型为基础。 一个缺失的令牌生成器使两个编码器能够将不完整的数据作为输入,使模型能够坚固地对抗缺失模式,无论是图像缺失还是表格数据缺失.
我们评价在阿尔茨海默氏病的两个具有挑战性的纵向临床任务(预测疾病阶段的转化和预测酰胺状态)上学到的多模式表述在临床上的用处。 拟议的方法超过了强有力的多式联运和单一模式基线。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Individuals suffering from dementia caused by Alzheimer’s disease can be categorised into three stages: stable mild cognitive impairment (sMCI), progressive MCI (pMCI), and Alzheimer’s disease (AD) [ 19 ] . Accurately predicting the transition of disease stages can improve treatment planning, and enable early intervention; ultimately improving quality of life for the patients, their families, and carers [ 7 ] . While deep learning models applied to medical images show promising prediction performance, recent works have shown that combining imaging scans with tabular data further improves prediction performance [ 5 , 9 , 29 ] .
blocks.zh: 老年痴呆症患者可分为三个阶段:稳定的轻度认知障碍(sMCI)、进步性MCI(pMCI)和老年痴呆症[19]。 准确预测疾病阶段的过渡,可以改善治疗规划,使早期干预成为可能;最终改善患者、其家人和照料者的生活质量[7]。 虽然应用于医疗图像的深层学习模型显示出有希望的预测性能,但最近的著作表明,将成像扫描与表格数据相结合,进一步提高了预测性能[5,9,29].

blocks.en: For Alzheimer’s disease assessment, magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans capture the structural changes of the brain and tabular data, such as cognitive test scores, assesses the performance, attention speed and memory. Multimodal models can take advantage of the different information captured in the modalities, improving diagnostic accuracy [ 6 ] . Nevertheless, multimodal medical data often suffers from data incompleteness: either with missing imaging scans, or with missing tabular entries. Even for well-curated studies such as the Alzheimer’s Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) [ 19 ] . Consequently, multimodal models that can effectively learn from such incomplete datasets must be robust to missing data. Existing models such as [ 6 , 27 ] tackle the missing data issue by using bespoke architectures to learn a fused multimodal representation. However, they cannot be effectively scaled as their unique structure prevents the use of pretrained encoders. Training these models requires both supervision labels and paired image-tabular data.
blocks.zh: 对于阿尔茨海默症的疾病评估,磁共振成像(MRI)扫描可以捕捉大脑的结构变化和表格数据,如认知测试分数,评估性能,注意力速度和记忆. 多式联运模式可以利用模式中获取的不同信息,提高诊断准确性[6]. 然而,多式医疗数据往往存在数据不全的问题:要么缺少成像扫描,要么缺少表格条目。 即使是对阿尔茨海默氏病神经成像倡议等精密研究而言,[19]。 因此,能够从这种不完整的数据集中有效学习的多式联运模型必须健全到缺失的数据。 现有模式,如[6、27],通过使用标语架构来学习一种组合式的多式联运,解决缺失的数据问题。 然而,由于它们的独特结构阻止使用事先训练过的编码器,因此它们无法有效缩放. 培训这些模型既需要监督标签,也需要成对的图像表格数据。

blocks.en: To alleviate the need to train the encoders in a supervised way, pretrained unimodal encoders from foundation models offer a promising alternative which provide the base for building and finetuning a multimodal model [ 8 ] . However, there are limited publicly available pretrained encoders for 3D brain MRI scans due to the computational challenge in 3D pretraining. In addition, pretrained encoders are typically not designed to handle missing data modalities.
blocks.zh: 为了减轻以监督方式培训编码员的需要,从基础模型中预先培训的单式编码员提供了一个有希望的替代办法,为构建和微调多式联运模型提供了基础[8]。 然而,由于3D预训中的计算挑战,3D脑磁共振扫描的公开预导编码器有限. 此外,预先训练的编码器一般不是用来处理缺失的数据模式的.

blocks.en: To address these limitations, in this work, we present MMAP, a novel Multimodal Missing-aware Alignment Pretraining method that can learn from incomplete multimodal data and leverage pretrained encoders from foundation models. Our contributions are: 1. An efficient sigmoid contrastive loss is combined with generative reconstruction loss, to improve the representation learning performance for the 3D brain MRI image encoder. 2. A cross-modal missing token generator is developed, which enables the multimodal model to handle missing image data, missing tabular data, and incomplete tabular data. 3. For two clinically challenging longitudinal tasks, disease conversion prediction and amyloid status prediction for AD, the multimodal model achieves promising prediction performance even with missing input data, performing better or on par with state-of-the-art unimodal and multimodal models.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些局限性,我们在这项工作中介绍了MMAP,这是一种新型的Multimodule miss-aware understanding Pretraining方法,可以学习不完整的多式联运数据,并利用基础模型中经过预先培训的编码器。 我们的贡献是: 1. 高效的Sigmoid对比性损失与基因重建损失相结合,以改善3D脑磁共振图像编码器的表达学习性能。 2. 开发了一个跨模式缺失的符号生成器,使多式联运模型能够处理缺失的图像数据、缺失的表格数据和不完整的表格数据。 3. 对于两个临床上具有挑战性的纵向任务,即对反倾销的疾病转化预测和酰胺状况预测,即使缺少输入数据,多式联运模型也取得了有希望的预测性能,表现更好或与最先进的单式和多式联运模型相当。

blocks.en: An efficient sigmoid contrastive loss is combined with generative reconstruction loss, to improve the representation learning performance for the 3D brain MRI image encoder.
blocks.zh: 高效的sigmoid对比性损失与基因重建损失相结合,以提高3D脑磁共振图像编码器的表达学习性能.

blocks.en: A cross-modal missing token generator is developed, which enables the multimodal model to handle missing image data, missing tabular data, and incomplete tabular data.
blocks.zh: 开发了一个跨模式缺失的令牌生成器,使多式联运模型能够处理缺失的图像数据,缺失的表格数据和不完整的表格数据.

blocks.en: For two clinically challenging longitudinal tasks, disease conversion prediction and amyloid status prediction for AD, the multimodal model achieves promising prediction performance even with missing input data, performing better or on par with state-of-the-art unimodal and multimodal models.
blocks.zh: 对于在临床上具有挑战性的纵向任务 -- -- 疾病转化预测和AD的酰胺状态预测 -- -- 而言,即使缺少输入数据,多式联运模型也取得了有希望的预测性能,表现更好或与最先进的单式和多式联运模型相当。

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: Image-tabular classification. Various works have focused on improving AD classification and longitudinal prediction by using multimodal approaches to combine MRI image modality with tabular cognitive test scores [ 6 , 13 , 17 , 27 ] . In [ 5 ] , an image-tabular framework was introduced to perform multimodal downstream tasks, while being robust to missing tabular columns by using a masked tabular reconstruction task to predict missing columns. HyperFusion [ 6 ] and DAFT [ 27 ] apply image-tabular learning to AD classification using the ADNI dataset [ 19 ] . They both use an integrated early fusion approach, wherein the encoded tabular features are inserted into blocks of a 3D CNN image encoder. However, this approach may not be robust to missing modalities. Moreover, both methods use an intermediate feature-level fusion approach, which does not allow for utilising pretrained unimodal encoders.
blocks.zh: 图像表分类. 各种工作侧重于改进反倾销分类和纵向预测,方法是采用多种模式将磁共振图像模式与表式认知测试分数[6、13、17、27]结合起来。 在[5]中,采用了一个图像表框架来完成多式联运下游任务,同时通过使用蒙面的表格重建任务来预测缺失的列来坚挺到缺少表列. HyperFusion [6] 和 DAFT [27] 使用 ADNI 数据集对 AD 分类应用图像表学习 [19]. 他们都采用综合的早期聚变方法,其中编码的表格功能被插入到3D CNN图像编码器的块中. 然而,这种办法可能无法弥补缺少的模式。 此外,两种方法都采用中间特性级聚变方法,不允许使用事先经过培训的单式编码器。

blocks.en: Contrastive multimodal pretraining. One of the first contrastive image-tabular works was proposed by Hager et al. [ 9 ] , which found that aligning imaging features with tabular features improved image-only downstream task performance. In [ 8 ] , a fusion module is used to fuse image and tabular features from frozen pretrained foundation models. It also introduces missing modality tokens, which are learnable tokens for missing image or tabular modalities. Contrastive learning is utilised to align multimodal embeddings of complete data with missing image features or missing tabular features [ 8 ] . This improved the performance of the model in unimodal settings and created a model robust to missing data and able to leverage existing pretrained models.
blocks.zh: 矛盾的多式联运预训。 最早的对比图像表的作品之一由Hager等人提出. [9],它发现,将成像特征与表格特征相配合,改善了仅图像的下游任务性能. 在[8]中,一个聚变模块用于从被冷冻的预先训练的基础模型中熔化图像和表格式特征. 它还引入了缺失模式符,它们是缺失图像或表格模式的可学习符. 利用相互矛盾的学习使完整数据的多式联运嵌入与缺失的图像特性或缺失的表格特性一致 [8]。 这改善了该模型在单模式环境下的性能,并创造了一个能够弥补数据缺失并能够利用现有预先培训的模型的模型。

blocks.en: Combining contrastive and generative pretraining. This approach of combining contrastive and generative self-supervised pretraining has been explored in iBOT [ 30 ] , which combined the contrastive alignment of the student-teacher model introduced by DINO with the generative task of masked image modelling. The iBOT loss was later incorporated into DINOv3 to improve local feature learning [ 23 ] . SigLIP2 [ 24 ] adds additional generative tasks to multimodal pretraining, by adding an auto-regressive decoder to perform image-to-text captioning and referring expression prediction [ 25 , 26 ] . These works demonstrate that generative tasks improve the learning for dense image features and performance in object localisation tasks.
blocks.zh: 结合对比性与遗传性预训. iBOT[30]中探讨了这种将对比性与基因自我监督的预训相结合的方法,将DINO引入的学生-教师模型的对比性对接与蒙面图像建模的基因任务结合起来. iBOT损失后来被纳入DINOv3,以改善本地特色学习[23]. SigLIP2 [24] 在多式联运预训中添加了额外的基因任务,增加了一个自动递归解码器来进行图像到文本的字幕和引用表达预测[25,26]. 这些作品表明,基因任务在对象定位任务中改善了密集图像特征和性能的学习.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 1: Architecture of MMAP, which consists of modality-specific encoders, an image decoder, a multimodal fusion module and a projection head. a. Scenario when both image and tabular data are available. Image and tabular features are concatenated, fused and projected to x m x_{m} . b. Scenario when one modality (e.g. image) is missing. A cross-modal token generator generates the image feature from available tabular features, fused and projected to tabular-only projection x t x_{t} .
blocks.zh: 图1: MMAP的架构,由模式特定编码器,图像解码器,多式联运聚变模块和一个投影头组成. a. 提供图像和表格数据时的设想。 图像和表格特性被调和、连接和投射到x m x_{m}. b. 缺少一种模式(如图像)时的情景。 跨模式符号生成器会从可用的表格特性中生成图像特性,被熔化并投射到只显示表格的投影 x t x_{t}.

blocks.en: We propose a multimodal pretraining method, MMAP, for a model that consists of an image encoder for 3D medical images and a tabular encoder for non-imaging clinical data. Pretraining learns features from both modalities and aligns their representations. A fusion module integrates the image features with the tabular features and a projection head projects them to multimodal features x m x_{m} , as shown in Figure 1 a. In the missing modality scenario, e.g. with missing image, a tabular-to-image cross-modal token generator is used to generate the missing image features from the available tabular features, which are then fused and projected to multimodal features x t x_{t} , as shown in Figure 1 b. Similarly, if tabular data is missing, an image-to-tabular cross-modal token generator is used to generate the missing tabular features from the available image features, which are then fused and projected to multimodal features x i x_{i} . During pre-training, we will combine the contrastive learning loss for x m x_{m} , x i x_{i} , x t x_{t} and a generative loss to reconstruct the input image via an image decoder.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一种多式联运预训方法,即MMAP,用于一种模型,它包括3D医疗图像的图像编码器和非成像临床数据的表格编码器. 预训从两种方式中学习特征,并协调其表述。 如图1 a所示,一个聚变模块将图像特性与表格特性结合起来,一个投影头将它们投射到xm x_{m}的多式联运特性中。 如图1b所示,在缺失模式情景中,例如图像缺失时,使用表格到图像的交叉符号生成器从可用的表格特征中生成缺失的图像特征,这些特征然后被连接并投射到多式联运特征 x t x_{t}。 同样,如果缺少表格数据,则使用一个图像到表格的跨模式符号生成器,从现有的图像特性中生成缺失的表格特性,然后这些特性被熔化并投射到多式联运特性 xi x_{i}。 在预训期间,我们将结合x m x_{m},x i x_{i},x t x_{t}的对比性学习损失和基因损失,通过图像解码器重建输入图像.

blocks.en: Modality encoders, image decoder and multimodal fusion. For the image encoder, a 3D ResNet-18 architecture is used with instance normalisation [ 10 ] . The encoded image features are provided to an image decoder (Figure 1 a), comprised of five blocks of 3D convolutional LeakyReLU and upsampling layers, to perform image reconstruction. For the tabular encoder, a pretrained encoder from the tabular foundation model TabPFNv2 [ 12 ] is used. Apart from the advantage of being pre-trained on large-scale tabular data, TabPFNv2 has an inherent tabular generative model, which can predict missing entries. This allows our method to be robust to missing tabular entries, in addition to missing modalities. The fusion module, adapted from [ 8 ] , performs layer normalisation for image and tabular features, concatenates them, and passes them through an MLP. After the fusion module, the projection head projects the fused features into a joint projection space; we use a MLP projection head with 2 layers.
blocks.zh: 模块化编码器,图像解码器和多式联运聚变器. 对于图像编码器,使用一个3D ResNet-18架构进行实例正常化[10]. 编码的图像特性提供给一个图像解码器(图1a),它由5块3D演化的LeakyReLU和提升的层组成,以进行图像重建. 对于表格编码器,使用从表格基础模型TabPFNv2[12]中预选的编码器. 除了在大型表格数据上接受预训的优点外,TabPFNv2还拥有内在的表型基因模型,可以预测缺失条目. 这使得我们的方法能够强大起来,除了缺少模式之外,还缺少表格条目。 由[8]改编而成的聚变模块,进行图象和表格特性的层态化,使其整齐,并通过MLP. 聚变模块后,投影头将被熔化的特征投射到一个联合投影空间;我们使用一个带有2层的MLP投影头.

blocks.en: Combining contrastive and generative learning. We employ SigLIP loss for cross-modal contrastive learning [ 28 ] . SigLIP loss maximises the cosine similarity between the features of two modalities. Instead of using unimodal features, we align the multimodal projected features x m x_{m} with the tabular-only projection x t x_{t} , and with the image-only projection x i x_{i} . The SigLIP contrastive loss for the multimodal and tabular only projections is formulated as, ℒ t , m c ​ o ​ n = ∑ t ∈ N ∑ m ∈ N log ​ 1 1 + e z t , m ( − τ 𝐱 𝐭 ⋅ 𝐲 𝐦 + b ) . \mathcal{L}^{con}_{t,m}=\sum_{t\in N}\sum_{m\in N}\textrm{log}\frac{1}{1+e^{z_{t,m}(-\tau\mathbf{x_{t}}\cdot\mathbf{y_{m}}+b)}}. (1) where N N denotes the batch size, t t and m m denote the sample indices in a batch, 𝐱 𝐭 \mathbf{x_{t}} denotes the tabular-only projection for sample t t , 𝐲 𝐦 \mathbf{y_{m}} denotes the multimodal projection for sample m m . z t , m = 1 z_{t,m}=1 if t = m t=m for paired data, otherwise z t , m = − 1 z_{t,m}=-1 . τ \tau and b b are learnable hyperparameters. Unlike CLIP’s softmax contrastive loss [ 21 ] , SigLIP uses independent sigmoid losses over pairs. SigLIP loss was selected because preliminary experiments showed that SigLIP gave an improved performance over CLIP. In addition to formulating the constrastive loss ℒ t , m c ​ o ​ n \mathcal{L}^{con}_{t,m} , we formulate a similar ℒ i , m c ​ o ​ n \mathcal{L}^{con}_{i,m} to align multimodal projection x m x_{m} with image-only projection x i x_{i} .

blocks.en: Contrastive learning focuses on learning global image-wise features. To improve the performance of local feature learning, we add a generative reconstruction loss ℒ r ​ e ​ c ​ o ​ n \mathcal{L}_{recon} , using the image decoder to perform reconstruction. ℒ r ​ e ​ c ​ o ​ n \mathcal{L}_{recon} is defined as the the mean-squared error loss between reconstructed image and the input MRI image. The total pretraining loss is, ℒ p ​ r ​ e ​ t ​ r ​ a ​ i ​ n = λ r ​ e ​ c ​ o ​ n ​ s ​ ℒ r ​ e ​ c ​ o ​ n + λ c ​ o ​ n ​ ( ℒ i , m c ​ o ​ n + ℒ t , m c ​ o ​ n ) , \mathcal{L}_{pretrain}=\lambda_{recons}\mathcal{L}_{recon}+\lambda_{con}(\mathcal{L}^{con}_{i,m}+\mathcal{L}^{con}_{t,m}), (2) where ℒ i , m c ​ o ​ n \mathcal{L}^{con}_{i,m} and ℒ t , m c ​ o ​ n \mathcal{L}^{con}_{t,m} are the contrastive losses between the image-only (missing tabular) and the multimodal projections, and the tabular-only (missing image) and multimodal projections respectively. λ c ​ o ​ n \lambda_{con} and λ r ​ e ​ c ​ o ​ n ​ s \lambda_{recons} are scalar constants.
blocks.zh: 对比性学习侧重于学习全球图像特性。 为了提高本地特性学习的性能,我们增加了基因重建损失L r e c o n \ mathcal{L}_{recon},使用图像解码器进行重建. L r e c o n \ mathcal{L}_{recon} 被定义为重建的图像和输入的磁共振图像之间的平均值错误损失 。 预训损失总额为:L p r r t a i n = λ r e c o n s r e c o n + λ c  n n (L i, m c o n + L t, m c o n ),\ mathcal{ L}_{ pretrain}=\lambda_{recons}\ mathcal{L}_{recon}+\lambda_{con}(\mathcal{L}^{q}^{con}_{i,m}+\m}+\athcal{L}^{con}_{t,m}), (2) Li, m c o n\ mathcal{L}^{con}_{i, m} 和 L t, m c o o n\ mathcal{L}^{con}_{t, m} 分别是只图像(缺少表格)和多模式预测,以及只表格(缺少图像)和多模式预测之间的对比损失. {\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}还有 {\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}是卡路里常数

blocks.en: Missing token generation. To achieve robustness against missing modalities, previous works [ 15 , 1 , 8 ] either utilise zero tokens to represent missing data embeddings, or utilise a learnable missing token. Here we propose a missing token generative method, generating tokens of the missing modality from the available modality, implemented as a cross-modal MLP projection head. For example, if the image is missing, its embedding will be predicted by the cross-modal token generator from tabular data, as shown in Fig. 1 b. Similarly, the embedding for missing tabular data will be predicted from the image. The parameters of the token generator are trained both during pretraining and finetuning.
blocks.zh: 缺少代号生成 。 为了在缺失模式下实现稳健性,以前的作品[15, 1, 8] 要么使用零符号表示缺失的数据嵌入,要么使用可学习的缺失符号. 我们在此提出一个缺失的代号基因方法,从可用模式中生成缺失模式的代号,作为跨模式的 MLP 投影头执行. 例如,如果图像缺失,其嵌入会由跨模式符号生成器从表格数据中预测,如图1b所示。 同样,缺失表格数据的嵌入也会从图像中预测。 符号生成器的参数在预训和微调期间都经过训练.

blocks.en: Finetuning. After pretraining, we take the pretrained multimodal model to perform finetuning for downstream tasks. We remove the projection head and add a classification head made from a linear leakyReLU and linear layer, added after the fusion module. For each sample, we get three different predictions, the prediction with full multimodal input data, the image-only prediction, and the tabular-only prediction. We optimise a total finetuning loss, by adding together the cross-entropy loss of the three training scenarios with equal weighting, formulated as, ℒ f ​ i ​ n ​ e ​ t ​ u ​ n ​ e = ℒ i + ℒ t + ℒ i , t , \mathcal{L}_{finetune}=\mathcal{L}_{i}+\mathcal{L}_{t}+\mathcal{L}_{i,t}, (3) where ℒ i , t \mathcal{L}_{i,t} denotes the cross-entropy loss of the multimodal prediction compared to ground truth label, ℒ i \mathcal{L}_{i} denotes the cross-entropy loss of the image-only prediction, and ℒ t \mathcal{L}_{t} denotes the cross-entropy loss of the tabular-only prediction. We use an ensemble model, where the final prediction is a simple average of the predictions provided by the five ensemble models, using the same ensemble methodology as Hyperfusion [ 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 微调. 经过预训后,我们采用预训的多式联运模式来进行下游任务的微调. 我们去掉投影头,并添加一个从线性泄漏的RELU和线性层中制成的分类头,在聚变模块后添加. 对于每个样本,我们得到三个不同的预测,一个带有完整的多式联运输入数据的预测,一个只图像的预测,一个只表格的预测. 我们优化了完全微调损失,将三场训练场景的跨纵横损失加在一起,以同等权重计算,其表述为:L fi n e t e e = L i + L t i , t , t ,\ mathcal{ finetune }=\ mathcal{ L}_{t}+\t}+\mathcal{ L}_{i, t}表示多模式预测的跨纵横损失与地面真实标签相比,L i\mathcal{L}_{i}表示图像唯一预测的跨纵横损失,Lt\mathcal{L}_{t}表示表格唯一预测的跨纵横横损失。 我们使用综艺模型,其中最终预测是五个综艺模型提供的预测的简单平均值,使用与超聚[6]相同的综艺方法.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: Dataset. We use 3D imaging and tabular data from 1,258 subjects from ADNI, consisting of T1 MRI scans with corresponding tabular cognitive and clinical test scores [ 19 ] . The MRI scans are preprocessed, following the same pipeline as [ 16 ] , followed by z-score intensity normalisation and image downsampling to the size of 128 × \times 128 × \times 128. It is a longitudinal dataset with data being collected for each subject at multiple timepoints. In total, 5,548 MRI scans and tabular data are available, consisting of 1,442 cognitively normal (CN), 3,370 MCI, and 736 AD. The MCI group is further divided into two subgroups: subjects who have a future AD diagnosis (pMCI) and those who remain stable MCI (sMCI). The full dataset is split into 85%/15% for pretraining and test, in a subject-wise manner to avoid information leakage. After pretraining, the model is finetuned on a subset of pretraining data, with equally sized pMCI and sMCI groups, with a total of 2,232 scans. The finetuned model is then evaluated on the test set, which was unseen during training.
blocks.zh: 数据集. 我们使用来自ADNI的1,258个学科的3D成像和表格数据,由T1核磁共振扫描组成,具有相应的表格认知和临床测试分数[19]. 核磁共振扫描经过预处理,遵循与[16]相同的管线,然后Z-分数强度正常化,图像取样下降至128×××128×××××128. 这是一个纵向数据集,在多个时点为每个主题收集数据。 共有5 548个核磁共振扫描和表格数据,包括1 442个认知正常(CN)、3 370个MCI和736个AD。 MCI小组进一步分为两个分组:未来有AD诊断(pMCI)的学科和保持稳定的MCI(sMCI)的学科. 完整的数据集在预训和测试中分为85%/15%,按科目划分,以避免信息泄露. 经过预训后,该模型在预训数据的一个子集上微调,具有同样大小的pMCI和sMCI组,共计2,232个扫描. 微调的模型随后在测试集上进行评估,测试集在训练中是看不见的.

blocks.en: Downstream evaluation tasks. On the test set, the model is evaluated on two clinically challenging tasks: 1) predicting whether an individual with MCI will remain stable (sMCI) or progress to AD (pMCI) at a future timepoint, with longitudinal ground truth diagnoses; 2) predicting the amyloid status of the individual at a future timepoint. Longitudinal diagnoses are provided by ADNI [ 19 ] and the code for defining the longitudinal labels from the tabular diagnoses is from [ 20 ] . The amyloid status is a binary variable, indicating the presence of amyloid plaques on a positron emission tomography (PET) scan. The amyloid status is labelled as positive if the standardised uptake value ratio (SUVR) is greater than a threshold of 0.79, and otherwise labelled as negative [ 4 , 14 ] . PET scans are expensive and not widely accessible, so predicting amyloid status from MRI scans and tabular data is clinically useful for disease diagnosis and monitoring [ 3 , 20 ] . Both tasks are longitudinal tasks, where the model is given clinical data at the current timepoint and predicts the class at a future timepoint, which is 1 to 3 years after the input data was acquired.
blocks.zh: 下游评价任务. 在测试中,该模型被评价在临床上具有挑战性的两个任务: 1) 预测拥有MCI的个人在未来某个时间点是否将保持稳定(sMCI)或向AD(pMCI)的进展,并进行纵向地面真伪诊断;2) 预测未来某个时间点个人的酰胺状态. 纵向诊断由ADNI[19]提供,表格诊断中纵向标签的定义代码来自[20]。 酰基状态是一个二进制变量,表明在正态排放图谱扫描(PET)上存在酰基图谱. 如果标准化的吸收值比(SUVR)大于0.79的阈值,否则被标记为负[4,14],则酰胺状态被标记为正值。 PET扫描很贵,而且不易广泛获取,因此从核磁共振扫描和表格数据中预测酰胺状态在临床上对疾病诊断和监测[3,20]有用. 这两个任务都是纵向任务,即模型在目前时间点得到临床数据,并在未来时间点预测类,即输入数据获得后的1-3年.

blocks.en: Implementation. The model was pretrained for 100 epochs with λ c ​ o ​ n = 1 \lambda_{con}=1 and λ r ​ e ​ c ​ o ​ n ​ s = 4 \lambda_{recons}=4 , with a learning rate of 0.0005, weight decay of 1 ​ e − 5 1e^{-5} and a batch size of 60. It was then finetuned for 50 epochs with a learning rate of 0.0008, the same weight decay and batch size. Preliminary experiments showed that finetuning the tabular encoder, TabPFNv2, led to a performance drop. For this reason, we kept the tabular encoder frozen in all experiments.
5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: Table 1 compares the proposed method, MMAP, to multimodal image-tabular models when both data modalities are available, including: HyperFusion [ 6 ] , DAFT [ 27 ] , TIP [ 5 ] , SimCLR-pretrained image encoder concatenated with TabPFNv2 tabular encoder (SimCLR + Concat) and autoencoder-pretrained image encoder concatenated with TabPFNv2 tabular encoder (AE + Concat). It shows that MMAP outperforms these competing methods in the amyloid prediction task, in terms of balanced accuracy (BACC), area-under-curve (AUC), and F1 score. For the disease stage conversion prediction task, MMAP outperforms competing methods in BACC and AUC, and only underperforms in F1 score.
blocks.zh: 表1将两种数据模式都可用时的拟议方法MMAP与多式联运图像表模型进行比较,包括:HyperFusion [6],DAFT [27],TIP [5],SimCLR预装图像编码器与TabPFNv2预装编码器(SimCLR + Concat)和自动编码器预装图像编码器与TabPFNv2预装编码器(AE + Concat). 它表明,从平衡准确性(BACC),曲线下的区域(AUC)和F1分数来看,MMAP在酰胺预测任务中比这些相互竞争的方法要好. 对于疾病阶段转换预测任务,MMAP在BACC和AUC中优于竞争方法,在F1分数中只优于表现.

blocks.en: Because MMAP can generate features for missing data modality, it enables prediction even when only one data modality is available. Table 1 also compares MMAP to AE when only image is available, and compares MMAP to TabPFNv2 when only tabular data is available. It shows that MMAP outperforms unimodal models in most of the metrics, while being robust to missing modalities. We also notice that when both data modalities are available, MMAP performs better than unimodal models. This is unsurprising, as the performance gain of aligning image with tabular features has been shown in previous works [ 8 , 9 , 22 , 29 ] .
blocks.zh: 由于MMAP可以为缺失的数据模式生成特性,因此即使在只有一种数据模式可用的情况下也能进行预测. 表1还将只有图像时的MMAP与AE进行比较,并将只有表格数据时的MMAP与TabPFNv2进行比较. 这表明,MMAP在大多数衡量标准中优于单式模型,同时强于缺失模式. 我们也注意到,在两种数据模式都可用的情况下,MMAP的性能优于单式模型. 这并不令人惊奇,因为将图像与表格特征相匹配的性能收益在以前的作品[8,9,22,29]中已经显示.

blocks.en:
Table 1: Comparison of the proposed MMAP method to other multimodal image-tabular models and unimodal models, in terms of amyloid status prediction and MCI conversion (pMCI vs sMCI) prediction performance. Modality (Mod): image (I), tabular (T). Metrics reported are Balanced Accuracy (BACC), AUC, and F1 score. Experiments were run five times with random seeds, with the mean and standard deviation reported.
For fair comparison, the DAFT implementation was taken from the same repository as [ 6 ] , and the TIP implementation was adapted to use a 3D ResNet-18. Bold numbers indicate the best result within each modality setting; underlined numbers indicate the best result overall.

blocks.zh: 表2:对不同损失术语的研究,以及将MCI中缺失的模式特征归为AD转换预测性能的不同方法. 5个随机种子的计量。 I + T是图像和表型情景.

blocks.en: Ablation studies. Table 2 details the results of the ablation studies of the effect of different loss terms on the model performance in the AD conversion prediction task. The results show that combining the reconstructive loss, L r ​ e ​ c ​ o ​ n L_{recon} with the contrastive loss, L c ​ o ​ n L_{con} improves downstream task performance. Adding in the L r ​ e ​ c ​ o ​ n L_{recon} loss gives a greater increase in accuracy compared to contrastive loss only, in the image-tabular and image only scenarios (2.3% and 2.5%), but only a very small improvement in the tabular-only scenario (0.3%). Combining reconstructive and contrastive losses is complementary and improves balanced accuracy on all data scenarios. We also ablate the finetuning loss when using only the multimodal ℒ i , t \mathcal{L}_{i,t} cross-entopy loss. Compared to when we combine it with the image only, ℒ i \mathcal{L}_{i} and tabular only ℒ t \mathcal{L}_{t} cross-entropy loss. This gives a small 1% balanced accuracy improvement on the multimodal performance. But it gives a greater improvement in the unimodal, image-only and tabular-only tasks, the model learns to perform well regardless of which modalities are available at test time. This confirms that optimising for all input data scenarios during finetuning acts as a form of regularisation, consistent with finding in a prior work [ 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 校勘学. 表2详细列出了AD转换预测任务中不同损失条款对模型性能影响的减值研究结果. 结果表明,重建损失(L r e c o n L_{recon)与对比性损失(L c o n L_{con)相结合,提高了下游任务性能. 在L r e c o n L_{recon} 损失中增加精度比对比性损失的精度更高,在图像表和图像中只增加2.3%和2.5%,但只增加表格表的精度(0.3%)。 将重建损失和对比损失结合起来是相辅相成的,提高了所有数据假设的均衡准确性。 我们还在只使用多模式 L i, t\ mathcal{L}_{i, t} 跨实体损失时减轻微调损失 。 相比于我们仅与图像结合时, L i\ mathcal{L}_{i} 和只表 L t\ mathcal{L}_{t} 交叉交替丢失 。 这使多式联运的性能略有1%的平衡准确性改进。 但是,它使单式,图像专用和表格专用的任务有了更大的改进,无论测试时有哪些模式,模型都学会了良好的表现. 这证实,在微调时优化所有输入数据情景可作为一种正规化形式,与以前的工作[8]中的发现一致。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 6. 结论

blocks.en: We present a novel multimodal pretraining method, MMAP, that can perform 3D image-tabular pretraining with missing modalities. MMAP achieves the best or comparable performance on both MCI to AD conversion prediction and the prediction of future presence of amyloid plaques compared to state-of-the-art methods. Our pretraining method, which combines multimodal contrastive learning with generative reconstruction, improves the performance on downstream longitudinal prediction tasks. In clinical practice, patients without MRI scans or incomplete or missing cognitive test scores are commonplace. MMAP addresses this with the missing token generator, which enables a multimodal model to perform robust prediction tasks against missing modalities and incomplete tabular data. It shows the potential in closing the gap between multimodal prediction models and real-world clinical applications with data incompleteness. Future directions include evaluating this method on other medical image-tabular datasets and pathologies, and extending the cross-modal token generation method to settings with more than two modalities.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了一种新型的多式联运预训方法,即MMAP,它可以进行3D图像表预训,但缺少模式。 MMAP在MCI到AD转化预测和与最先进的方法相比对酰基平板的未来存在的预测上都取得了最佳或可比较的性能. 我们的预训方法结合了多模式对比学习和基因重建,提高了下游纵向预测任务的业绩. 在临床实践中,没有核磁共振扫描或认知测试分数不完整或缺失的患者是常见的. MMAP用缺失的代号生成器来解决这个问题,这使得多式联运模型能够针对缺失的模式和不完整的表格数据执行强力预测任务. 它显示了缩小多式联运预测模型与数据不完整的现实世界临床应用之间的差距的潜力。 未来的方向包括用其他医学图像表数据集和病理学来评价这种方法,并将跨模式代号生成方法推广到两种以上的设置.
